import pygame
pygame.init()

# Game constants
WIN_WIDTH = 640
WIN_HEIGHT = 480
BLOCK_SIZE = 20
SNAKE_SPEED = 10

# Colors
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
GREEN = (0, 255, 0)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

# Set up the game window
win_width = WIN_WIDTH
win_height = WIN_HEIGHT
win = pygame.display.set_mode((win_width, win_height))
pygame.display.set_caption('Eagle Town')

# Game variables
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Snake initial position and direction
snake = [(WIN_WIDTH // 2, WIN_HEIGHT // 2)]
snake_direction = 'RIGHT'

# Main game loop
running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_UP and snake_direction != 'DOWN':
                snake_direction = 'UP'
            elif event.key == pygame.K_DOWN and snake_direction != 'UP':
                snake_direction = 'DOWN'
            elif event.key == pygame.K_LEFT and snake_direction != 'RIGHT':
                snake_direction = 'LEFT'
            elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT and snake_direction != 'LEFT':
                snake_direction = 'RIGHT'

    # Move the snake
    head_x, head_y = snake[0]
    if snake_direction == 'UP':
        new_head = (head_x, head_y - BLOCK_SIZE)
    elif snake_direction == 'DOWN':
        new_head = (head_x, head_y + BLOCK_SIZE)
    elif snake_direction == 'LEFT':
        new_head = (head_x - BLOCK_SIZE, head_y)
    elif snake_direction == 'RIGHT':
        new_head = (head_x + BLOCK_SIZE, head_y)
    
    # Check for collision with walls
    if (new_head[0] < 0 or new_head[0] >= win_width or 
        new_head[1] < 0 or new_head[1] >= win_height):
        running = False
    
    # Add new head to the front of the snake
    snake.insert(0, new_head)
    
    # Draw the snake
    win.fill(BLACK)
    for segment in snake:
        pygame.draw.rect(win, GREEN, (segment[0], segment[1], BLOCK_SIZE, BLOCK_SIZE))
    
    # Update the display
    pygame.display.update()
    clock.tick(SNAKE_SPEED)

pygame.quit()

import pygame

def main():
    pygame.init()
    
    # Game settings
    SCREEN_WIDTH = 640
    SCREEN_HEIGHT = 480
    FPS = 60
    
    # Eagle settings
    EAGLE_SIZE = 128
    EAGLE_SPEED = 5
    
    # Set up the screen
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Space Rocks")
    
    # Set up the clock
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    
    # Eagle position and velocity
    eagle_x = SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - 64
    eagle_y = SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2 - 64
    eagle_dx = 0
    eagle_dy = 0
    
    # Game loop
    running = True
    while running:
        # Handle events
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            
            # Arrow key movement
            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
                    eagle_dx = -EAGLE_SPEED
                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
                    eagle_dx = EAGLE_SPEED
                elif event.key == pygame.K_UP:
                    eagle_dy = -EAGLE_SPEED
                elif event.key == pygame.K_DOWN:
                    eagle_dy = EAGLE_SPEED
            
            # Stop movement when key is released
            if event.type == pygame.KEYUP:
                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT and eagle_dx < 0:
                    eagle_dx = 0
                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT and eagle_dx > 0:
                    eagle_dx = 0
                elif event.key == pygame.K_UP and eagle_dy < 0:
                    eagle_dy = 0
                elif event.key == pygame.K_DOWN and eagle_dy > 0:
                    eagle_dy = 0
        
        # Update eagle position
        eagle_x += eagle_dx
        eagle_y += eagle_dy
        
        # Keep eagle on screen
        if eagle_x < 0:
            eagle_x = 0
        if eagle_x > SCREEN_WIDTH - EAGLE_SIZE:
            eagle_x = SCREEN_WIDTH - EAGLE_SIZE
        if eagle_y < 0:
            eagle_y = 0
        if eagle_y > SCREEN_HEIGHT - EAGLE_SIZE:
            eagle_y = SCREEN_HEIGHT - EAGLE_SIZE
        
        # Fill the screen with black
        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
        
        # Draw the eagle
        eagle_image = pygame.image.load('assets/eagle.png')
        eagle_image = pygame.transform.scale(eagle_image, (EAGLE_SIZE, EAGLE_SIZE))
        screen.blit(eagle_image, (eagle_x, eagle_y))
        
        # Update the display
        pygame.display.flip()
        
        # Control the frame rate
        clock.tick(FPS)
    
    # Quit Pygame
    pygame.quit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import pygame
import sys

pygame.init()

# Screen dimensions
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 640, 480

# Colors
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)

# Create screen
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("Eagle Town - Start Screen")

# Load cat image
cat_image = pygame.image.load("assets/eagle.png")
cat_image = pygame.transform.scale(cat_image, (200, 200))

# Start screen variables
running = True

while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_RETURN:
                # Start the main game
                running = False

    screen.fill(BLACK)
    screen.blit(cat_image, (WIDTH//2 - 100, HEIGHT//2 - 100))
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 36)
    text = font.render("Press Enter to Start", True, WHITE)
    screen.blit(text, (WIDTH//2 - 150, HEIGHT//2 + 100))
    pygame.display.flip()

pygame.quit()
sys.exit()

    {"x": 600, "y": 400, "width": 100, "height": 150, "color": (139, 69, 19},  # brown
]

BACKGROUND_CLOUDS = [
    {"x": 100, "y": 100, "width": 150, "height": 50, "color": (255, 255, 255)},  # white
    {"x": 400, "y": 80, "width": 200, "height": 60, "color": (255, 255, 255)},  # white
    {"x": 550, "y": 150, "width": 120, "height": 40, "color": (255, 255, 255)},  # white
]

# Background drawing function
def draw_background(screen, buildings, clouds):
    """Draw background buildings and clouds"""
    for building in buildings:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, building["color"], (building["x"], building["y"], building["width"], building["height"]))
    for cloud in clouds:
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, cloud["color"], (cloud["x"], cloud["y"], cloud["width"], cloud["height"]))
    for cloud in clouds:
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, cloud["color"], (cloud["x"]+20, cloud["y"]+10, cloud["width"]-40, cloud["height"]-20))
    for cloud in clouds:
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, cloud["color"], (cloud["x"]+40, cloud["y"]+20, cloud["width"]-80, cloud["height"]-40))
